name: momo-image
description: Generate and edit images through the local MOMO API Proxy, storing results on the user's computer without exposing API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, save, and edit local images with MOMO.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for MOMO image generation and editing through the locally configured proxy. Generated images stay on the user's computer and are reused by opaque asset ID.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MOMO Image to generate or edit an image.
